newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's inflation seen remaining high.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's inflation seen remaining high.

text.p: Indonesia's consumer price index for 1996 and 1997 is expected to remain above the government's target, the official Antara news agency reported on Monday.
Antara quoted a report from the Central Bureau of Statistics as saying the country's annual inflation in 1996 and 1997 was forecast at 8.54 and 8.92 percent, respectively.
The report said the anticipated rise was higher than the government target of keeping inflation below five percent.
Indonesia's inflation in the first eight months was 4.98 percent. Inflation in 1995 was 8.64 percent.
